headline: Enduring shells built for decades on the mountain
body: Patrol-grade craftsmanship designed for those who appreciate lasting quality over fleeting trends. Quietly reliable technical outerwear for serious skiers.
rationale: This copy targets the Affluent Classic by leaning entirely into heritage, craftsmanship, and understated tone. It avoids price points and discounts entirely due to low price sensitivity, and uses no trendy or loud language.
